title: Dissecting the regulatory logic of specification and differentiation during vertebrate embryogenesis.
authors: Liu, Jialin; Castillo-Hair, Sebastian M; Du, Lucia Y; Wang, Yiqun; Carte, Adam N; Colomer-Rosell, Mariona; Yin, Christopher; Seelig, Georg; Schier, Alexander F
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文利用单细胞多组学与深度学习模型预测染色质可及性，解析转录因子驱动的胚胎分化调控逻辑，虽非直接TF-DNA结合建模，但方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: The interplay between transcription factors and chromatin accessibility regulates cell type diversification during vertebrate embryogenesis. To systematically decipher the gene regulatory logic guiding this process, we generated a single-cell multi-omics atlas of RNA expression and chromatin accessibility during early zebrafish embryogenesis. We developed a deep learning model to predict chromatin accessibility based on DNA sequence and found that a small number of transcription factors underlie cell-type-specific chromatin landscapes. While Nanog is well-established in promoting pluripotency, we discovered a new function in priming the enhancer accessibility of mesendodermal genes. In addition to the classical stepwise mode of differentiation, we describe instant differentiation, where pluripotent cells skip intermediate fate transitions and terminally differentiate. Reconstruction of gene regulatory interactions reveals that this process is driven by a shallow network in which maternally deposited regulators activate a small set of transcription factors that co-regulate hundreds of differentiation genes. Notably, misexpression of these transcription factors in pluripotent cells is sufficient to ectopically activate their targets. This study provides a rich resource for analyzing embryonic gene regulation and reveals the regulatory logic of instant differentiation.
abstract_zh: 转录因子与染色质可及性之间的相互作用调控脊椎动物胚胎发生过程中的细胞类型多样化。为了系统解析指导这一过程的基因调控逻辑，我们生成了斑马鱼早期胚胎发生过程中RNA表达和染色质可及性的单细胞多组学图谱。我们开发了一种基于DNA序列预测染色质可及性的深度学习模型，并发现少数转录因子构成了细胞类型特异性染色质景观的基础。尽管Nanog在促进多能性方面已被充分确立，我们发现了其在启动中内胚层基因增强子可及性方面的新功能。除了经典的逐步分化模式外，我们还描述了即时分化，即多能细胞跳过中间命运转变并终末分化。基因调控相互作用的重建揭示，这一过程由浅层网络驱动，其中母源沉积的调控因子激活一小部分转录因子，这些转录因子共同调控数百个分化基因。值得注意的是，这些转录因子在多能细胞中的异位表达足以异位激活其靶标。本研究为分析胚胎基因调控提供了丰富资源，并揭示了即时分化的调控逻辑。
